notes.title: A DEMO OF MASKA'S MASKS HAS BEEN RELEASED
notes.notes:
A demo of Maska's Masks has been released, welcome to download it to play.
At present, the content of the demo is the beginning of the first episode, the main purpose is to test the gameplay and style.
Hope you put forward Suggestions and Suggestions for improvement, we will release the official version as soon as possible.
